body.name: All-cells Layer-2.5 translation of an ordinary \(Q[S]\) kernel
body.construction:
Translate the full ordinary kernel \(Q[S_0]\) to the finite all-cells family of single-world unnested Layer-2.5 events
\[
 \left\{P((S_0)_x=s):x\in\mathfrak X_{V\setminus S_0},\ s\in\mathfrak X_{S_0}\right\}.
\]
The physical encoding stores this as one symbolic all-cells query schema whose branch table ranges over every intervention assignment \(x\); a successful factor law supplies every outcome cell \(s\).  Translate each input kernel \(Q[V\setminus B](\cdot;b)\) to the labelled slice law \(P_b(V\setminus B)\).  No cross-world variable is introduced.
